projectSummary: A second independent record of pectoralis major tendon rupture occurring during the index exercise. The subsequent fracture is a complication of the surgical repair and is outside this project's scope, which does not give treatment or rehabilitation advice.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: n = 1; the post-operative complication is not a training harm and is recorded but not carried into any claim.

study.population: A 45-year-old man sustained an acute left pectoralis major tendon rupture at the humeral insertion while performing a bench press manoeuvre, underwent acute surgical repair, and about eight weeks postoperatively fell from standing height and sustained a proximal humerus shaft fracture through the repair site at the bone trough.

title: Proximal humerus shaft fracture after pectoralis major tendon rupture repair.
